blurb: Timberlake Marina offers boat slip rentals including standard wet slips, premier slips, boat lift slips, and jet ski slips with floats. They also operate a boat club providing access to a fleet of recreational watercraft without ownership responsibilities. The marina is located on Lake Murray, providing access to a large lake with scenic views and recreational opportunities.
